chinese: 於比丘尼眾中復有諸比丘尼，皆是菩薩，人中之龍，位階十地安住不動，為化眾生現受女身，而常修四無量心，得自在力，能化作佛。
english:
Everyone, let us go quickly,
            quickly!

chinese: 爾時復有一恒河沙菩薩摩訶薩，人中之龍，位階十地安住不動，方便現身。
english: The Tathāgata will surely enter nirvāṇa before long.

chinese: 其名曰：海德菩薩、無盡意菩薩，如是等菩薩摩訶薩而為上首。
english:
They said this as well:

            The world is empty, the world is empty!

chinese: 其心皆悉敬重大乘，安住大乘，深解大乘，愛樂大乘，守護大乘，善能隨順一切世間，作是誓言：「諸未度者，當令得度。
english:
From now on we will have no
            one to rescue us, no one to honor.

chinese: 」已於過世無數劫中，修持淨戒，善持所行，解未解者，紹三寶種使不斷絕，於未來世當轉法輪，以大莊嚴而自莊嚴，成就如是無量功德，等觀眾生如視一子。
english: We will be destitute and defenseless.

chinese: 亦於晨朝，日初出時遇佛光明，舉身毛竪，遍體血現如波羅奢花，涕泣盈目生大苦惱。
english:
Once the peerless World-Honored One is gone, to whom will we direct
            our questions should doubts arise?

chinese: 亦為利益安樂眾生，成就大乘第一空行，顯發如來方便密教，為不斷絕種種說法，為諸眾生調伏因緣故，疾至佛所稽首佛足，繞百千匝，合掌恭敬，却坐一面。
english:
366a      At that time there were innumerable great disciples [of the Buddha] present,
       including Venerable Mahākātyāna, Venerable Vakkula, and Venerable
       Upananda.

chinese: 爾時復有二恒河諸優婆塞，受持五戒，威儀具足，其名曰：威德無垢稱王優婆塞、善德優婆塞等而為上首，深樂觀察諸對治門，所謂苦樂、常無常、淨不淨、我無我、實不實、歸依非歸依、眾生非眾生、恒非恒、安非安、為無為、斷斷、涅槃非涅槃、增上非增上，常樂觀察如是等法對治之門，亦欲樂聞無上大乘，如所聞已，能為他說。
english:
When they encountered the radiance of the Buddha, the bodies
       of these great bhikṣus began to quiver until they were seized by an uncon-
       trollable shaking.Their minds grew turbid, they became disoriented, and they
       raised their voices in a loud cry.

chinese: 善持淨戒，渴仰大乘，既自充足，復能充足餘渴仰者。
english:
They were stricken with a variety of troubles
       like this.

chinese: 善能攝取無上智慧，愛樂大乘，守護大乘。
english: At the time eight million monks were also assembled, and all were arhats.

chinese: 善能隨順一切世間，度未度者，解未解者。
english:
Their minds were freed, their tasks were accomplished, they were free of
       the deﬁlements, and they had tamed their cognitive senses.

chinese: 紹三寶種使不斷絕，於未來世當轉法輪，以大莊嚴而自莊嚴，心常深味清淨戒行，悉能成就如是功德，於諸眾生生大悲心，平等無二如視一子。
english:
Like the great
       dragon kings, they possessed great spiritual power.

chinese: 亦於晨朝日初出時，為欲闍毘如來身故，人人各取香木萬束、栴檀沈水、牛頭栴檀、天木香等，是一一木，文理及附，皆有七寶微妙光明，譬如種種雜彩畫飾，以佛力故有是妙色，青黃赤白，為諸眾生之所樂見。
english:
Accomplished in the
       wisdom of emptiness (śūnyatā), what they had gained personally was akin
                                                                       Fascicle I

to a sandalwood grove with rows of sandalwood trees in every direction;
they were like lion kings surrounded by prides of lions.

chinese: 諸木皆以種種香塗，欝金沈水及膠香等，散以諸花而為莊嚴，優鉢羅花、拘物頭花、波頭摩花、分陀利花。
english:
Thus it can be said
that these monks had achieved an incalculable amount of merit and virtue,
and every one of them was a true child of the Buddha.

chinese: 諸香木上懸五色幡，柔軟微妙猶如天衣，憍奢耶衣芻摩繒綵。
english:
As the sun began to rise in the early morning sky, the monks emerged
from their lodgings and were cleaning their teeth when they came upon the
Buddha’s light.

chinese: 是諸香木載以寶車，是諸寶車出種種光，青黃赤白。
english:
They said to each other, “Quickly, rinse your mouths and
wash your hands!” After this exchange, their hair stood on end all over their
bodies, and their blood ﬂowed so strongly that they looked like the [scarlet]
palāśa ﬂower.7 Tears ﬁlled their eyes and they felt great discomfort.

chinese: 轅皆以七寶廁填，是一一車駕以馬，是一一馬駿疾如風。
english:
Wanting
to give blessings and peace of mind to living beings, to accomplish the primary
Mahāyāna practice of emptiness, to reveal the recondite teaching (saṃdhā-
vacana) that is the Tathāgata’s skillful means, to prevent the extinction of his
sermons, and to provide causes and conditions for living beings to discipline
themselves, the monks rushed to where the Buddha was and bowed down at
his feet.

chinese: 一一車前竪立五十七寶妙幢，真金羅網彌覆其上，一一寶車復有五十微妙寶蓋，一一車上垂諸花鬘，優鉢羅花、拘物頭花、波頭摩花、分陀利花，其花純以真金為葉，金剛為臺。
english:
Circumambulating him one hundred thousand times, they then placed
their palms together in reverence, withdrew, and sat at one side.

chinese: 是花臺中多有黑蜂，遊集其中歡娛受樂，又出妙音，所謂無常、苦、空、無我，是音聲中，復說菩薩本所行道。
english:
At that time from among the *Kuṇḍala women, Subhadrā, Upanandā,
Sāgaramatī, and six billion other nuns were present.

chinese: 復有種種歌舞伎樂、箏笛、箜篌、簫瑟、鼓吹，是樂音中復出是言：「苦哉，苦哉，世間空虛。
english:
All of them were also
great arhats: their contaminants were exhausted, their minds were freed, their
tasks were accomplished, they were free of the deﬁlements, and they had
tamed their cognitive senses.

chinese: 」一一車前，有優婆塞擎四寶案，是諸案上有種種花，優鉢羅花、拘物頭花、波頭摩花、分陀利花，欝金諸香及餘薰香，微妙第一。
english:
They were like huge dragons in possessing
great spiritual power, and were accomplished in the wisdom of emptiness.

chinese: 諸優婆塞為佛及僧，辦諸食具，種種備足，皆是栴檀沈水香薪，八功德水之所成熟，其食甘美有六種味：一苦、二、三甘、四辛、五醎、六淡。
english:
Just like [the monks], when the sun began to rise in the early morning, the
hair of these nuns stood on end all over their bodies and their blood ﬂowed
so strongly that they looked like the palāśa ﬂower.

chinese: 復有三德：一者輕軟、二者淨潔、三者如法，作如是等種種莊嚴。
english:
Tears ﬁlled their eyes and
they felt great discomfort.

chinese: 至力士生處娑羅雙樹間，復以金沙遍布其地，以陵伽衣、欽婆羅衣及繒綵衣而覆沙上，周匝遍滿十二由旬。
english:
Wanting to give blessings and peace of mind to
living beings, to accomplish the primary Mahāyāna practice of emptiness,
to reveal the hidden teaching that is the Tathāgata’s skillful means, to prevent
the extinction of his sermons, and to provide causes and conditions for living
beings to discipline themselves, they rushed to where the Buddha was and
bowed down at his feet.

chinese: 為佛及僧敷置七寶師子之座，其座高大如須彌山，是諸座上皆有寶帳，垂諸瓔珞。
english:
Circumambulating him one hundred thousand times,
they then placed their palms together in reverence, withdrew, and sat at one
side.

chinese: 諸娑羅樹，悉懸種種微妙幡蓋，種種好香以塗樹身，種種名花以散樹間。
english:
In this gathering of nuns, they were all bodhisattvas, dragons among the
people, for in rank they were ﬁrmly settled within the ten stages (daśabhūmi)
        The Nirvana Sutra, Volume I

       from which they could not be moved.

chinese: 諸優婆塞各作是念：「一切眾生若有所乏，須食與食、須飲與飲、須頭與頭、須目與目，隨諸眾生所須之物，皆悉給與。
english:
Having taken on female bodies in order
       to spiritually transform living beings, they were constantly cultivating the
       four immeasurable minds8 and had attained positions where they were freely
366b   able to attain buddhahood.

chinese: 」作是施時，離欲瞋恚、穢濁毒心，無餘思惟求世福樂，唯期無上清淨菩提。
english:
Also at that time there were bodhisattva-mahāsattvas as numerous as grains
       of sand in the Ganges River.

chinese: 是優婆塞等，皆已安住於菩道，復作是念：「如來今者受我食已，當入涅槃。
english:
They, too, were dragons among the people, and
       in rank they were ﬁrmly settled within the ten stages from which they could
       not be moved.

chinese: 」作是念已，身毛皆竪，遍體血現如波羅奢花，涕泣盈目生大苦惱，各各齎持供養之具，載以寶車、香木、幢幡、寶蓋、飲食，疾至佛所稽首佛足，以其所持供養之具，供養如來，遶百千匝，舉聲號泣，哀動地，搥胸大叫，淚下如雨，復相謂言：「苦哉，仁者！
english:
Through their power of using expedient means, they manifested
       themselves in their present bodies with names such as the bodhisattva Oceanlike
       Virtue (*Samudradatta) and the bodhisattva Imperishable Resolve (Akṣayamati).

chinese: 世間空虛，世間空虛。
english: Such bodhisattva-mahāsattvas as these led this group.

chinese: 」便自舉身，投如來前，而白佛言：「唯願如來，哀受我等最後供養。
english:
Their thoughts were
       ﬁlled with reverence for the Mahāyāna: they were ﬁrmly settled in the
       Mahāyāna, they deeply appreciated the Mahāyāna, they longed for the
       Mahāyāna, and they were unwaveringly devoted to the Mahāyāna.

chinese: 」世尊知時默然不受。
english:
In skillfully
       adapting to the ways of the whole world, each made the following pledge:

           I will enable all those who have not yet reached the other shore to do
           so.

chinese: 如是三請，悉皆不許。
english:
Throughout innumerable past kalpas, I have upheld the pure precepts,
           maintained well the practices, and liberated those who had not yet been
           liberated, [thereby] binding together the Three Jewels to prevent their
           dissolution.
